records.title: Editor AI grounding: a deterministic figure check now exists but is advisory; accept is not blocked, ungrounded drafting still proceeds, and the legacy edit-section route still marks any [SRC-n] sentence SUPPORTED
records.evidenceAtHead: (1) server/services/ana/answer-grounding.ts (answer-check/2): checkAnswer (lines ~242-310) now extracts figures (answer-check-figures.ts) and settles each claim as found / notFound / unchecked / fromPerson / fromInput; the header (lines 40-46) says the check 'is advisory: shown to the person and sealed in the turn record, never used to block or rewrite the answer'. I ran a scratch tsx script against it: evidence '31% (n=120)' vs answer '45% ... [SRC-1]' gave notFound ['45%']; the faithful answer gave notFound []; with no sources the basis was 'no_sources' and every figure was unchecked. So the check catches the fabricated figure. (2) server/routes/authoring.router.ts:3785, POST /sections/:sectionId/ai/draft (the canonical 'Draft from sources' door, client surfaces/AuthoringAiDraft.tsx, mounted from editor/DocumentWorkbench.tsx:84): retrievalStatus is ok, empty or failed (3874, 3883), and the model is still called when it is empty or failed (the response message says 'AI draft generated WITHOUT Data Room evidence'). Evidence now sits in a single user message (3916-3943), not the system role. The draft check comes from draftTurn.drafted (4000-4008) and is returned as draft.check. (3) server/routes/authoring.router.ts:4142, POST .../ai/draft/accept: never reads the check. The client shows AnswerCheckRows (AuthoringAiDraft.tsx:283-297), but the Accept button (754-756) is disabled only on accepting||docSealed. (4) server/routes/c2c/ai-editing.ts:122, /ai/edit-section (mounted at /api/concept2cure behind authenticateToken, register-concept2cure-routes.ts:37; grep of client/src finds no caller at 92ccdba1 or at HEAD). Lines 452-454 are unchanged: refs.size>0 gives 'SUPPORTED', and WEAK is never assigned. evidenceBlock still goes in the system role (350-369). A retrieval failure is now reported as retrievalStatus 'failed' (255-260) and no longer swallowed, but generation continues. The same holds for /ai/templates/:templateId/generate (1048). (5) server/services/ai-governance/groundedness.ts is unchanged since the audit: it is a citation-marker coverage proxy used by review-policy.ts evaluateAcceptGate. (6) The no-tools ratio-1 complaint is fixed for AnA: server/routes/ana-ri/post-processing.ts:469 uses the ratio only when check.basis==='sources'.
records.fixedBy: a3775bcef and ef70b10f4: server/services/ana/answer-grounding.ts checkAnswer with figures (answer-check-figures.ts, answer-check-sources.ts). b0038b034: server/services/ana/turn-record-draft.ts, plus authoring.router.ts:4000-4008, which checks the draft against the evidence shown and returns draft.check. 425d44dd3: a retrieval failure is reported instead of swallowed (server/routes/c2c/ai-editing.ts:255-260, server/routes/authoring.router.ts:3883).
records.remaining: (1) The figure check is advisory. POST /api/authoring/sections/:sectionId/ai/draft/accept (authoring.router.ts:4142) commits model-written sentences whose figures the engine reported notFound, with no block and no attributed acknowledgement. (2) Claim-bearing drafting is not refused when retrieval is empty or failed: authoring.router.ts:3874 and 3883, and ai-editing.ts edit-section and templates/generate. (3) The check matches a figure against any shown source, not the chunk the sentence cites. (4) /api/concept2cure/ai/edit-section still labels any sentence carrying [SRC-n] as SUPPORTED, persists that label to ai_claims, and keeps evidence in the system role. It is mounted and reachable by API, although no client calls it. (5) groundedness.ts, the accept-time proxy, still counts citation markers.
records.severityRationale: 'Draft from sources' is the Authoring launch journey. Once a PQ-passed model serves it in production (AI-01), a fabricated figure the engine has already flagged notFound can be accepted into a governed section with no block and no recorded acknowledgement. GxP buyers test exactly this data-integrity control. It stays below P0 because the flag is visible before accept and a human must accept.
records.humanTestingNote: In Authoring, open a section and choose 'Draft from sources'. The check panel lists figures 'not found' in the Data Room sources, but 'Accept and record citations' stays enabled and saves them. With no relevant Data Room documents, or during a retrieval outage, a draft is still generated, labelled 'no Data Room sources above the relevance threshold' or 'WITHOUT Data Room evidence'. Workaround: log every not-found row as a defect and edit the figure before accepting, and upload source documents to the project Vault before drafting. Under NODE_ENV=production drafting is refused outright (no PQ-passed model, AI-01), so exercise this on a local non-production build with a provider key.
records.instructions:
Work on concept2cure-v2 only (Rule 0).
1. Failing-first test for the block. In server/routes/__tests__/authoringAiDraftAccept.test.ts (or a new sibling), park a draft candidate whose generated content says 'response rate was 45% (n=120)' while its parked source chunk says '31% (n=120)'. Assert that POST /sections/:id/ai/draft/accept returns 409 with code UNSUPPORTED_FIGURES and that authoring_sections.content is unchanged. Run it and record it red.
2. Implement the block. In server/routes/authoring.router.ts, in the accept handler at line 4142, after consumeDraftCandidate (inside the transaction), build EvidenceEntry[] from the candidate's parked sources ({source:'context', content}). Run checkAnswer(generatedDraft, entries) from server/services/ana/answer-grounding.ts. For each figure in check.notFound (and, when the draft had no sources, each figure in check.unchecked), find its sentence in the generated draft (reuse splitSentences, or the sentence splitter in answer-check-sources.ts). If that sentence still appears verbatim in acceptedContent, ROLLBACK and return 409 {code:'UNSUPPORTED_FIGURES', figures:[...]}. Sentences the author edited are the author's own words and are not blocked. Record the figure list and the check engine version (ANSWER_CHECK_VERSION) on the existing accept audit entry, whatever the outcome.
3. Client. In client/src/concept2cure/v2/surfaces/AuthoringAiDraft.tsx, render the 409 as a calm, factual refusal that names the figures, and keep the draft in the buffer so the author can edit it. Update the copy in DraftCheck (lines 283-297) to say that accept is refused while a not-found figure stays unedited. Add a client test.
4. Refuse ungrounded drafting. In POST /sections/:sectionId/ai/draft (authoring.router.ts:3785), when retrievalStatus is 'empty', return 422 {code:'NO_EVIDENCE'} before gw.route. When it is 'failed', return 503 {code:'RETRIEVAL_FAILED'}. In both cases file the turn with fileFailedDraftTurn. Write the tests red first: mock retrieval to return zero hits or to throw, and assert that gw.route is not called.
5. Make the check per citation. Extend checkAnswer, or add a wrapper in turn-record-draft.ts, so that a figure in a sentence the model attributed (the modelAttributions quote and src from parseDraftEnvelope) must be found in that src's chunk, not just in any shown chunk. Add a unit test in which the figure exists only in SRC-2 but is attributed to SRC-1, and assert notFound.
6. Legacy route. ai-editing.ts /ai/edit-section (line 122) and /ai/templates/:templateId/generate (line 1048) have no client caller. First run the working-agreement history search: git log --all --diff-filter=D -- 'client/**/*Editor*' 'client/**/*Canvas*', and grep client/ for 'concept2cure/ai'. If nothing calls them, delete both handlers and their tests, and name in the commit message the replacement, POST /api/authoring/sections/:sectionId/ai/draft (client/src/concept2cure/v2/surfaces/AuthoringAiDraft.tsx, reached from editor/DocumentWorkbench.tsx:84), and the test that proves it is reachable (client/src/concept2cure/v2/__tests__/authoringAiDraft.test.tsx). If a caller is found, instead: move evidenceBlock out of systemPrompt (lines 350-361) into a separate delimited user message ahead of data.text; replace lines 452-454 so that a sentence is SUPPORTED only when it cites a valid SRC and every figure in it is found in that chunk (checkAnswer), WEAK when it cites but a figure is not found, and UNSUPPORTED otherwise; and return 422 when retrievalStatus !== 'ok' for the expand and add-references actions.
7. Replace the marker proxy at its source. In server/services/ai-governance/groundedness.ts, make resolveGroundedness prefer a supplied answer-check result, so that review-policy.ts evaluateAcceptGate blocks when notFound > 0. Keep the citation-coverage proxy only as a recorded signal.
8. Run the touched test files individually (not the whole suite). Re-run step 1's test and show it green, then revert the guard locally to show it red once more, and record both outputs in the commit message.
records.acceptance: (a) The new accept test fails at HEAD and passes after the change: a draft keeping an unedited sentence with '45%' against a '31%' source returns 409 UNSUPPORTED_FIGURES and leaves the section unchanged. The same draft with that sentence edited by the author accepts. (b) POST .../ai/draft with zero retrieval hits returns 422 NO_EVIDENCE, with a throwing retrieval returns 503 RETRIEVAL_FAILED, and gw.route is not called in either case (asserted via mock). (c) A figure attributed to SRC-1 that exists only in SRC-2 is reported notFound. (d) Either /api/concept2cure/ai/edit-section returns 404, with a commit message naming the replacement path and test, or a persisted ai_claims row for a cited sentence with a mismatched figure has status != 'SUPPORTED'. (e) The client test shows the refusal copy and the draft retained in the buffer.
records.dependencies: None to build. Testable in production only after AI-01, because high-risk drafting is refused there until a model passes PQ. The refusal copy should follow the regulatory-compliance-ux and microcopy-tone patterns.

records.title: No regulatory text corpus ships; a 24-entry guidance manifest now names the targets, but nothing is verified, downloaded or ingested
records.evidenceAtHead: (1) data/ich_guidelines/ holds only README.md (ls), unchanged since the audit. (2) server/jobs/corpusIngestionSweep.ts:153 is still ClinicalTrials.gov only and off unless ENABLE_CORPUS_INGESTION=true. git log 92ccdba1..HEAD on the file is empty, and grep of terraform/ for ENABLE_CORPUS_INGESTION finds nothing. (3) server/eval/rag/guidance-corpus-manifest.json is new since the audit (e41504ec7). It has 24 entries (ICH 12, US-FDA 6, US-CONGRESS 2, EU 3, EMA 1), and all 24 have verified:false and sha256:null, e.g. 'Not downloaded: database.ich.org refused by egress policy on 2026-09-28'. Its admission path is vault ingest into one dedicated evaluation organisation; there is no product-wide corpus. (4) server/services/regulatory-currency/guidance-ingestion-service.ts: fetchFdaGuidanceList now returns {status:'unavailable', reason:'no_guidance_index'} (fa596a0a7), which replaces the earlier behaviour of presenting openFDA substances as guidance. This is an honest empty state, not a corpus. (5) server/data/ich-guidelines-comprehensive.json is still 39,319 bytes of metadata. (6) grep for ecfr.gov or guidance ingesters in server/ and scripts/ finds only hand-curated rule modules (ivd-knowledge, labeling, combination-products) and currency-registry facts. No FDA guidance, CFR or eCTD spec text is stored for retrieval. (7) server/eval/pq/pq-protocol.json rag: required:true, executable:true. The verdict is INCOMPLETE without rag results, so PQ cannot pass until this corpus exists.
records.remaining: Everything the finding asked for. (1) No verified official text (FDA guidance, eCFR Title 21, ICH, EMA) is downloaded, hashed or ingested anywhere. (2) There is no delivery model for tenants: the manifest's admission targets only a dedicated evaluation org. (3) There is no staleness or currency sweep for ingested documents. (4) AnA guidance answers still rest on model recall, now honestly labelled as such. (5) PQ's rag component cannot run, which blocks AI-01.
records.severityRationale: The PQ rag component is required and fails closed without a verified, ingested corpus, so this corpus is on the critical path to any PQ pass (AI-01) and therefore to AI drafting in production. For pilot users, guidance questions are answered from model recall, now labelled unverified rather than fabricated, which keeps it below P0.
records.humanTestingNote: When a tester asks AnA about FDA or ICH guidance content, the guidance-search tool says no FDA guidance index is connected, citations show as recall or 'not checked against the regulator's text', and the substance comes from model knowledge. Workaround: upload the needed guidance PDFs into the test project's Vault so Data Room retrieval grounds the answer, and log guidance-currency questions as a known limitation, not a defect.
records.instructions:
Work on concept2cure-v2 only (Rule 0).
1. Founder. Decide reuse terms for each publisher in server/eval/rag/guidance-corpus-manifest.json (publishers.<publisher>.terms, termsUrl, termsVerified), at least ICH and EMA. FDA guidance and govinfo eCFR are public domain. Provide a machine whose egress can reach database.ich.org, www.fda.gov, www.govinfo.gov, eur-lex.europa.eu and www.ema.europa.eu; this container's proxy refused them on 2026-09-28.
2. Engineer, on that machine. Follow the manifest's verifyProcedure steps 1-6 for all 24 entries: record sourceUrl, sha256 of the downloaded bytes, retrievedAt, byte size and date, and set versionVerified and verified to true. Re-pin US-CFR to the latest govinfo annual edition. Change any re-pinned key in server/eval/rag/gold-dataset.json in the same commit. Store the files outside git if the terms forbid redistribution, and record the path.
3. Evaluation corpus. Create one dedicated evaluation organisation and programme. Ingest each verified file through the manifest's admission path (server/routes/vault-ingest.ts -> ingestVaultDocument -> vault.document_chunks). Run node scripts/verify-rag-corpus.mjs --org-uuid <eval-org-uuid>, which must exit 0 and report 24 documents. Check that every vault.documents.content_hash equals the manifest sha256.
4. Pilot-tenant corpus (product). Write scripts/corpus/seed-regulatory-corpus.mjs. It takes --org-uuid and --program-id, reads the manifest, refuses any entry with verified:false or a sha256 mismatch, and ingests through the same ingestVaultDocument path, idempotent on (programme, document_code, version). Tenant data stays organisation-scoped under the existing RLS, and no shared cross-tenant table is added. If a later design does need a table, put it in public with organization_id INTEGER NOT NULL, list it in C2C_MIGRATION_FILES before the final RLS sweep pair, and run npm run ci:migration-set-order and ci:migration-drop-safety (Rule 1).
5. Currency. Add server/jobs/regulatoryCorpusStalenessSweep.ts. It re-fetches each verified entry's sourceUrl HEAD and listing page on a schedule, compares the date and sha256, and marks an entry stale when either changed or when the check could not run (fail closed). AnA's guidance tools must then say 'stale' or 'unverified' for that document. Register the job next to corpusIngestionSweep, and give it a unit test that is red first, with a mocked changed hash.
6. Search. Change fetchFdaGuidanceList in server/services/regulatory-currency/guidance-ingestion-service.ts to search the org's ingested corpus and return document_code, version and effective date. Keep {status:'unavailable', reason:'no_guidance_index'} when the org has no corpus. Add a test for both branches.
7. Verify by failing first. Before ingesting, show verify-rag-corpus exiting non-zero for the eval org, and show a run-eval item with a tampered sha256 reported as INCOMPLETE.
records.acceptance: (a) Every answer-source entry in guidance-corpus-manifest.json has verified:true, a sha256, sourceUrl and date, and gold-dataset.json keysProvisional is false. (b) node scripts/verify-rag-corpus.mjs --org-uuid <eval-org> exits 0 with at least 24 documents, and exited non-zero before ingestion (output captured). (c) run-eval resolves keys for every positive gold item, so the hit-rate scores more than 0 items, and a tampered content_hash makes the run INCOMPLETE. (d) For a seeded pilot org, AnA's FDA guidance tool returns a document with a version and an effective date. For an unseeded org it still returns 'unavailable'. (e) The staleness sweep test flips an entry to stale on a changed hash, and the test was red before the job existed.
records.dependencies: Founder licensing decisions and network egress to issuer sites. A dedicated evaluation org. This is a prerequisite for AI-07 (rag gold keys resolve only against verified entries) and for AI-01 (PQ rag component).

records.title: Eval is still thin and lexical, not in CI, with no prompt-change gate; a gold-key-to-document resolver landed but has nothing verified to resolve
records.evidenceAtHead: (1) server/eval/rag/gold-dataset.json is now 0.3.0-seed (0.2.0-seed at 92ccdba1): still 20 items, 0 with expectedSourceIds, and 18 with expectedSourceKeys, all provisional (keysProvisional:true). Its own $comment says it is 'still BELOW the 30-50 the PQ needs, and not PQ-ready'. (2) server/eval/rag/run-eval.ts:22,241 now resolves keys to Vault document ids through server/eval/rag/qualification-corpus.ts resolveExpectedSources (0e0bb7ec4). Every manifest entry is verified:false, so no key can resolve (see AI-06). (3) server/eval/doc-quality/gold-tasks.json is unchanged since the audit: 42 tasks (510k, cer and ind, each 10 generation + 4 extraction), 0 captured candidates, still scored by substring coverage and forbidden phrases (doc-quality-metrics.ts). (4) grep of .github/workflows for ai:eval-doc-quality, pq:run, run-eval or eval:grounding finds nothing. The only 'eval' job is c2c-agent.yml:263 ai_prompt_eval: dispatch or full_audit only, tsc with '|| true' and grep heuristics, present at 92ccdba1. (5) scripts/ci has no prompt-hash or eval-freshness gate (ls: check-model-migration-agreement, check-pq-evaluation-callers, check-tenant-blind-models, check-unapproved-model-pins only). (6) server/eval/pq/ia-review-cases.json (new) has 34 cases, all reviewer-draft and approvedBy null, and states 'Not approved PQ gold'. (7) server/eval/pq/pq-protocol.json: status 'draft', approvedBy null.
records.remaining: (1) An SME-authored gold bank: at least 10 tasks per launch document type, and at least 100 retrieval items with evidence quotes and resolvable source keys. (2) Scoring beyond substring matching. (3) A nightly or CI eval and PQ regression run. (4) A gate requiring an eval re-run when a prompt changes. (5) The cosmetic ai_prompt_eval job, which still reads like a gate.
records.severityRationale: PQ (AI-01) cannot pass without an adequate gold bank and an executable rag eval, so AI drafting stays refused in production. Without a CI or nightly eval, edits to drafting prompts (for example the inline prompt in authoring.router.ts ai/draft) ship unregressed into a regulated drafting path.
records.instructions:
Work on concept2cure-v2 only (Rule 0).
1. SMEs (founder names them). Extend server/eval/rag/gold-dataset.json to at least 100 items: at least 50 positive items covering FDA, eCFR and ICH questions in pilot scope, each with evidence {document_code, section, quote} taken from the verified text (AI-06), expectedSourceKeys, and expectedAnswerContains drawn from the quote, plus negative controls. Set keysProvisional false once AI-06 verifies the keyed entries.
2. Doc-quality. Extend server/eval/doc-quality/gold-tasks.json to the pilot's launch document types (agree the list with the founder, e.g. IND Module 2 summaries, Module 3 sections, QMS SOPs), with at least 10 generation tasks per type. In server/eval/doc-quality/doc-quality-metrics.ts, add a figure-fidelity score that reuses figuresIn and figureHeld from server/services/ana/answer-check-figures.ts against each task's input, and fail any generated figure absent from the input. Keep substring coverage as a secondary metric. Add a unit test that is red first, with a fabricated figure.
3. Offline CI scoring. In .github/workflows/ci.yml, add a guardrail step that runs the doc-quality and rag scorers on committed captured candidates (no provider key needed), so a scorer regression fails the PR. Commit at least one captured candidate per task type.
4. Nightly live eval. Add .github/workflows/ai-eval-nightly.yml (schedule plus workflow_dispatch, ref concept2cure-v2). It provisions the eval DB, seeds the evaluation org corpus (AI-06 step 3), and runs npm run ai:eval-doc-quality -- --min-coverage 0.85 --min-f1 0.8 and tsx server/eval/rag/run-eval.ts --org-id ... --org-uuid ... --program-id ... with a provider key secret. The job fails on any threshold miss or an INCOMPLETE verdict. Show it failing once on a deliberately bad candidate before reporting it working.
5. Prompt-change gate. Write scripts/ci/check-prompt-eval-freshness.mjs with scripts/ci/prompt-eval-freshness-baseline.json. The baseline maps every prompt file under server/services/ai-gateway/prompts/** and every inline drafting prompt builder on a launch path (authoring.router.ts POST /sections/:sectionId/ai/draft, and AnA's draft_authoring_document prompt) to a sha256 and to the eval record (commit and run id) that last passed with that hash. The script fails when a hash changes without a matching updated record. Add --self-test, which copies a prompt to a temp dir, mutates it and must exit non-zero. Wire both into .husky/pre-push and the ci.yml guardrails, add npm scripts ci:prompt-eval-freshness and ci:prompt-eval-freshness:selftest, and run the selftest red first.
6. In .github/workflows/c2c-agent.yml, replace the ai_prompt_eval job (line 263 onward: tsc '|| true' and grep heuristics) with a call to the nightly workflow, or delete it, so no green check implies an eval ran.
records.acceptance: (a) gold-dataset.json has at least 100 items, every positive item has an evidence quote and resolvable keys, and keysProvisional is false. (b) doc-quality has at least 10 generation tasks per agreed launch document type, and the figure-fidelity metric fails a candidate containing a figure absent from its input (test red before the metric existed). (c) The ci.yml offline scoring step fails on a corrupted captured candidate (shown once). (d) The nightly workflow exists and failed once on a seeded bad candidate before passing. (e) npm run ci:prompt-eval-freshness:selftest exits non-zero on a mutated prompt, and editing server/services/ai-gateway/prompts/section-generation/* without updating the baseline fails pre-push.
records.dependencies: AI-06, so rag keys can resolve. SME authors. A provider API key stored as a CI secret. Founder approval of pq-protocol.json and the gold bank (AI-01).

records.title: Production provider election closes Moonshot and unelected OpenAI for every data class; Moonshot is kept as a development lane, and the reranker egress bypasses the election
records.evidenceAtHead: (1) d29275b1b (2026-10-01, after the audit) added server/services/ai-gateway/providers/org-placement.ts:69 PRODUCTION_DEFAULT_PROVIDERS={anthropic, bedrock, local}, :76 NEVER_IN_PRODUCTION_PROVIDERS={'moonshot'}, and :102 providerElectionRefusal. Under it, OpenAI, Azure and Vertex are used in production only when the org's ai_placement_policies row elects them. (2) server/services/ai-gateway/gateway.ts:1303 calls withoutExcludedProviders (4651), which disables the Moonshot lane and drops its key in production. The tenantPlacementVerdict comment (around 3462-3486) says the election and the tenant vendor/substrate allow-list apply 'for EVERY data class'. The verdict is applied at selection (3324), dispatch (1690), the last-mile re-check (3629) and via providerElectionDenial (4638). The writer refuses moonshot in production (org-placement-writer.ts:108). (3) Deployed environments run NODE_ENV=production: terraform/modules/ecs-fargate/main.tf:153,296 and .github/workflows/cerv2-staging-deploy.yml:256. (4) I ran: npx vitest run server/services/ai-gateway/providers/__tests__/org-placement-election.test.ts server/services/ai-gateway/__tests__/production-provider-election.test.ts, which passed 27/27. The cases include 'a Moonshot key that slipped through initialises no client', 'a stored policy that names moonshot does not make it reachable' and 'production with no election allows exactly anthropic, bedrock and local'. (5) Still present: Moonshot rows at gateway.ts:391-419, 'moonshot' in TASK_PROVIDER_PREFERENCES (gateway.ts:437-446), approved non-high-risk entries at approved-models.ts:176-209 (including the preview pin kimi-k2-0711-preview), and sensitive-placement-policy.ts:51, which still returns ALLOW_NON_SENSITIVE for any provider (now subordinate to tenantPlacementVerdict). (6) Fallbacks are recorded: tried_models in the ledger (audit.ts:67,397; gateway.ts:1503-1613), a column that already existed at the audit. (7) server/services/rag-reranker.ts:193-215 sends the query plus up to 2000 characters per chunk to api.cohere.com or api.voyageai.com by fetch whenever RAG_RERANKER_* is set. Its only guard is refuseModelCallHere (sub-agent scope). It does not consult providerElectionRefusal, and no production boot refusal exists for it. It is reachable from advancedRAGPipeline, which is imported by ana/citation-engine.ts and the clinical-regulatory-evidence retrieval modules. Terraform sets none of RAG_RERANKER_*, KIMI or MOONSHOT.
records.fixedBy: d29275b1b (P1-45, ADR-0014 section 1): server/services/ai-gateway/providers/org-placement.ts:69-117 and server/services/ai-gateway/gateway.ts:1303, 3479-3486, 4638-4665. Tests: server/services/ai-gateway/__tests__/production-provider-election.test.ts and providers/__tests__/org-placement-election.test.ts.
records.remaining: (1) Moonshot is retained as a development lane: registry rows, approved entries (including a preview pin) and the fallback preference. Outside NODE_ENV=production a set KIMI_API_KEY or MOONSHOT_API_KEY still routes non-PII content to Moonshot. (2) The cross-encoder reranker (rag-reranker.ts), and other baselined non-gateway egresses (huggingface-service.ts, nanoBananaService.ts), send tenant text to sub-processors outside the tenant election if an operator sets their env vars in production. (3) The published sub-processor list and the DPA wording must match PRODUCTION_DEFAULT_PROVIDERS and the elections (founder/legal).
records.severityRationale: Every deployed environment runs NODE_ENV=production, where Moonshot is disabled and refused, and tenant content of every data class reaches only Anthropic, Bedrock or local unless the org elects another vendor. That closes the pilot exposure the finding described, and tests prove it. What remains is latent: an operator-set reranker env var, and Moonshot code that a DPA reviewer will question. Both should be closed before enterprise GA.
records.humanTestingNote: Not observable in testing. Do not set KIMI_API_KEY, MOONSHOT_API_KEY or RAG_RERANKER_* in a local non-production environment that holds real pilot documents: outside NODE_ENV=production, Moonshot is still a fallback lane.
records.instructions:
Work on concept2cure-v2 only (Rule 0).
1. Founder. Decide whether Moonshot stays as a development lane (ADR-0014 section 1.3 kept it) or is deleted. Deletion is recommended so the codebase matches the DPA. Publish the sub-processor list as Anthropic and AWS (Bedrock) by default, with OpenAI, Azure and Vertex only on an org's election.
2. If Moonshot is deleted: remove the kimi-k2-0711, moonshot-v1-128k and moonshot-v1-32k rows from server/services/ai-gateway/gateway.ts (391-430) and server/services/ai-governance/approved-models.ts (176-209); remove 'moonshot' from TASK_PROVIDER_PREFERENCES (gateway.ts:437-446), executeMoonshot (gateway.ts:2936) and the client init (moonshotClient, gateway.ts:1293); remove it from PLACEMENT_PROVIDERS and NEVER_IN_PRODUCTION_PROVIDERS (org-placement.ts) and from VALID_PROVIDERS (org-placement-db.ts); and remove the effort.ts labels (232-234). This is not a user-facing capability, so no replacement path is needed. Say so in the commit. Then run node scripts/ci/check-model-migration-agreement.mjs, node scripts/ci/check-unapproved-model-pins.mjs and the approved-models drift tests, and update the two election tests to assert that moonshot is absent from getModels() in every environment.
3. Bring the reranker under the election. In server/services/rag-reranker.ts getReranker (line 268), when isProductionEnv(env) and RAG_RERANKER_PROVIDER is cohere or voyage with no RAG_RERANKER_BASE_URL on a self-hosted host, do not build CrossEncoderReranker unless a new explicit acknowledgement (RAG_RERANKER_SUBPROCESSOR_ACK naming the provider) is set.
